entities.summary: Marco Maurer is a Swiss professional ice hockey defenceman who currently plays with HC Sierre of the Swiss League (SL). He previously played with EV Zug, the SC Rapperswil-Jona Lakers, the ZSC Lions, HC Lugano and EHC Biel.
